title: Requirements Baselines — Parts 1–3 (Programme Completion)
scope: Requirement Baselines — immutable, integrity-fingerprinted, numbered collections of Requirement Content Versions, with full lifecycle (draft -> locked -> archived), persistence, API, permissions, and Workbench UI

part1.title: Domain & Architecture Foundations
delivered: RequirementBaseline aggregate and value objects
Draft/Locked/Archived state policy (no unlock/reverse transition)
Membership items reference content versions only
Repository port and domain event contracts
Domain tests

part2.title: Application Service, Persistence, API, Permissions
delivered: RequirementBaselineApplicationService orchestration (create, update draft, add/remove item, lock, archive, list, get, history, compare)
PostgreSQL + in-memory repository adapters
Migrations 0074/0075 (baseline table + RLS)
REST API routes and permissions qep.requirements.baselines.{view,create,modify,lock,archive,compare}
Domain event publication through the application service

part3.title: Integrity Fingerprinting & Workbench UI
delivered: Baseline integrity fingerprinting: SHA-256 canonical hash over membership + content-version snapshots (requirement-baseline-integrity.ts)
Empty-lock rejection: lockRequirementBaseline / transitionRequirementBaseline require at least one content-version member and computed integrity metadata

lockBaseline (application service) loads each content version, verifies integrity, builds membership inputs with snapshotHash, and persists integrity metadata (algorithm, schema version, verification status, verified-at)
verifyBaselineIntegrity command + POST /api/v1/qep/requirements/baselines/{baselineId}/verify + permission qep.requirements.baselines.verify
availableActions computed on the baseline DTO from status + permissions (edit, addItem, removeItem, lock, archive, compare, verifyIntegrity)
Migration 0076 (integrity columns)
Baseline comparison versionChanged detection (same requirementId, different content version) exposed via compareBaselines and the Compare Baselines UI

Workbench UI: list, create, detail (metadata, integrity status, contents table, add/remove version, lock/archive/verify confirmations), add-version flow, compare, and a Baseline History panel on the Requirement detail view
Client API and query keys for all baseline operations (apps/web/lib/qep/qep-api.ts, query-keys.ts)
Routes /workspace/qep/requirements/baselines, /new, /:id, /compare registered in presentation/routes.ts, navigation, and module.yaml
